subject: Post-call: Technical evaluation milestone — MAP draft and targets
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morris <taylor@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Technical evaluation milestone — MAP draft and targets

Thanks for your time earlier, Taylor — good alignment. Per our call, I drafted the technical-eval milestone for the Mutual Action Plan and captured concrete acceptance criteria so your engineering team can validate quickly. High level summary below and an ask list at the end.

Milestone: Technical evaluation (owner: HealthSync + Redwood SEs)
- Goal: Demonstrate parity/near-parity on production sample prompts and meet latency/cost SLOs for pilot scope.
- Target close (MAP milestone): 2026-10-28 (end of pilot acceptance window).

Benchmark success criteria (pass/fail):
1) Quality: generation outputs score >= 4.0 average (1-5 rubric) on 500 representative prompts (you provided) with no major factual regressions on 95% of prompts.
2) Latency: p95 token-completion latency <= 220 ms for 1,024-context single-request synthetic load; cold-start p99 < 500 ms.
3) Cost: effective inference unit cost <= $0.0012 per generated 1k tokens with Redwood batching/cache enabled.
4) Throughput: sustain 12 concurrent steady-state sessions with <15% tail-latency inflation vs single-session baseline.

Model shortlist for the evaluation (initial):
- RedSN-3B-quant (fastest, quantized)
- OpenAtlas-7B-ssf (balanced quality/cost)
- LlamaX-13B-compiled (quality baseline)

Dependencies and blocking items:
- HealthSync to share 500 labeled sample prompts and 50 adversarial cases (action: Taylor)
- NDA/POC terms signed or PO issued (action: Marissa/legal)
- Access: a test dataset endpoint + S3 read for cached prompt sets, and a small service account for trial (action: HealthSync ops)
- SRE/SE pair scheduled for the trial window (action: Redwood: Karthik & Ben)

Next steps (proposed):
1) HealthSync to upload prompts CSV to the shared Drive folder by Thu 09/16.
2) Redwood to provision trial environment and send runbook + instructions by Fri 09/17 (attachment: redwood_trial-instructions.pdf).
3) Kickoff bench run the week of 09/20 (2-3 days), then a 48h stability run.

Please confirm the prompt set timeline and whether the cost/latency targets look achievable from your side — we can tighten if you have stricter internal SLOs.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Post-call: Technical evaluation milestone — MAP draft and targets

Adding some technical clarifications we should include in the MAP so engineering has minimal back-and-forth during the trial:
- Harness: we'll run the benchmark over your 500 canonical prompts plus 100 stress-case prompts (we recommend 1,000 total synthetic queries to hit statistical confidence).
- Evaluation metrics: BLEU is noisy for this type; we'll use pairwise human-rated accuracy + a tuned semantic-similarity metric for automated gating. Acceptance = mean human score >= 4.0 AND automated similarity >= 0.78 on the test set.
- Runtime config: recommend running RedSN-3B-quant on a T4-equivalent (or A10) with 8-GB KV cache cap for pilot; LlamaX-13B compiled run on an A100-40GB for quality baseline. We'll supply config files.
- Quantization: we can test int8 and 4-bit quant to hit the cost target; note there may be a 2-5% quality delta for aggressive quant.
- Measurement: p95 latency measured on model-token completion (end-to-end including network hop to the trial agent). We'll provide the tracing headers.

I attached a short checklist for the bench run (I'll paste the run commands in the shared Drive doc). Also recommend an initial SE pair: Karthik + Neha for the kickoff.
- Karthik
SE, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — this looks good and aligned. A few clarifications from our side: 
- We can get the 500 canonical prompts to you by EOD Thu 09/16. We'll also flag 25 high-risk prompts we want to treat as blockers if they fail (we'll mark them in the CSV).
- The cost target looks reasonable, though our CFO prefers cost modeled as $/1M tokens for procurement. Can you translate the $0.0012/1k to a per-1M token projection?
- For the trial access: we'll need an SSO-backed service account and the SOC2 summary before we spin up anything. Please attach SOC2 and an outline of data retention for logs.

Forwarded for context:

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Taylor. Quick answers and next items: 
- Cost conversion: $0.0012 per 1k tokens ~= $1.20 per 1M tokens. We'll include both figures in the MAP so procurement can evaluate.
- SOC2 & data retention: attached SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf; retention: logs stored for 90 days by default (configurable up to 365 days for Private customers).
- Trial report: attaching a one-page sample results report template and the runbook (redwood_trial-instructions.pdf). We'll populate the first run and drop the report into the shared Drive folder after the bench run.

Responsibility matrix (MAP draft):
- HealthSync: upload prompts CSV + flag blockers (owner: Taylor) — due 2026-09-16
- Redwood SEs: bench runs, report generation, config delivery (owners: Karthik, Neha) — bench run 09/20-09/22, stability run 09/23-09/24
- Sales/Procurement: finalize PO/NDA (owner: Marissa) — target 2026-09-20

Target MAP close: 2026-10-28 (pilot acceptance) — can be adjusted if procurement needs more time.

Attachments referenced: healthsync_eval_prompts_09-14.csv (placeholder), redwood_trial-instructions.pdf, SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Mon 09/20 at 10:00 PT unless you prefer a different window. Please confirm.

Thanks again — looking forward to kicking this off.
